A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Matryoshka Multimodal Models and contain complete, readable main text, equations, Tables 1–9, Figures 1–6, and Appendices A–C. Text and visual inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original image and video benchmark evaluations, training ablations, and qualitative analyses of the proposed models.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, ablations, and qualitative analyses, including the appendix examples.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same pooling-based nested visual tokens, five token scales, model components, and loss averaged across scales. The new related-work comparison describes the existing method without changing its procedure.

E1.justification: Training data and image, OCR, and video evaluation coverage are unchanged. Table 1's caption changes from 'video understanding' to 'image understanding,' correcting its description of the same benchmarks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the benchmark tables, sampling comparisons, and ablations. The newly cited Matryoshka Query Transformer is discussed as concurrent work but is not added to an evaluated comparison.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the same 7B backbones, one-epoch training, token scales, six-frame video collage procedure, GPT-3.5 evaluation, oracle selection, and image-grid generalization settings.

E4.justification: Sections 4.4–4.5 retain the sampling comparisons, image-complexity cases, grid generalization, and training ablations. Appendix B's efficiency analysis and Appendix C's qualitative examples are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests. The reporting of point estimates is unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 and the figures retain the same numerical and qualitative results. Restoring 'drop' in Section 4.2 clarifies the TextVQA/DocVQA trend already shown in Table 2 and described in v1's introduction; it does not introduce a different finding.

T1.justification: The nested-representation definitions and likelihood and training-objective equations (3.1–3.2) are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about controllable visual granularity, strong performance with few tokens on natural-scene benchmarks, and the gap to oracle token selection.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning spatial structure, visual complexity, and distraction from long contexts remain unchanged. Both versions retain the limitation of lacking an effective token-scale predictor and Appendix A's bias discussion.

D1.justification: Learning rates, initialization, hardware, pooling details, and Appendix B's roofline-analysis assumptions are unchanged. The project link and statements about releasing code and models are also retained.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds a paragraph and reference to Hu et al.'s Matryoshka Query Transformer for Large Vision-Language Models. It acknowledges the shared variable-token objective and distinguishes that work's transformation layers from M3's spatially preserving average pooling. Existing references are retained.

P1.justification: v2 adds one related-work paragraph and restores the missing word 'drop' in Section 4.2. The section order and overall narrative remain unchanged, with only local text reflow.

P2.justification: Table 1's caption is corrected from video to image understanding, and the added paragraph and reference cause limited pagination and spacing changes. Figures, table structures, and appendix displays are otherwise unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 improves research positioning by acknowledging closely related concurrent work and explaining the methodological distinction. Correcting Table 1's task label and Section 4.2's missing 'drop' also improves clarity. These are limited gains; the methods, empirical support, and documented limitations remain unchanged.
